description: The chart represents the distribution of various categories within a dataset. The chart is divided into five slices, each representing a distinct category. The categories are labeled as "Pending Translations" (green), "Extra + Augmented Data" (blue), "Translated Sentences" (yellow), "Syntactic Roles" (brown), and "Semantic Categories" (purple). The chart includes numerical labels inside the slices, indicating the quantity of each category. The proportions of the categories are approximately 39% for "Pending Translations", 27% for "Extra + Augmented Data", 14% for "Translated Sentences", 21% for "Syntactic Roles", and less than 1% for "Semantic Categories". A legend is provided to the right of the chart, associating each category with its corresponding color. The slices are arranged in a doughnut chart, with the largest slice ("Pending Translations") on the left and the smallest slice ("Semantic Categories") at the top, and the other slices are arranged in a clockwise direction.
